name: Brave Browser - Debloat
description: Disables various annoyances like Brave Rewards, Leo AI, Crypto Wallet and VPN.
whatItDoes: Stops and removes Brave browser background telemetry, update services, and scheduled tasks.
sideEffects: Brave browser automatic background updates and promotional notifications will stop functioning.

name: RDP Unsigned File Warnings - Disable
description: Disables warnings shown when launching unsigned RDP files introduced with the latest Windows 10 and 11 updates.
whatItDoes: Sets RedirectionWarningDialogVersion to 1 in HKLM Terminal Services client policies and RdpLaunchConsentAccepted to 1 in HKCU Terminal Server Client settings.
sideEffects: Suppresses security warning dialogs when connecting to untrusted or self-signed Remote Desktop endpoints.

name: Microsoft Edge - Debloat
description: Disables various telemetry options, popups, and other annoyances in Edge.
whatItDoes: Disables background services, startup tasks, and promotional telemetry associated with Microsoft Edge.
sideEffects: Disables Edge automatic background updates and may impact WebView2-dependent system widgets.

name: Microsoft Edge - Remove
description: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge by creating dummy MicrosoftEdge.exe file in the legacy Edge folder. This tricks Windows into unlocking the official Edge uninstaller allowing for a system-level removal.

undo.script:
winget install Microsoft.Edge --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 3010 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne -1978335135 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne -1978335189) { throw "winget failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

warnings: Removes Microsoft Edge from the system. Some Windows components, widgets, or web-authentication dialogs may be affected. Undo reinstalls Edge via WinGet, but does NOT restore deleted user profile data or browsing history.
irreversibleReason: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge system binaries and deletes user profiles; undo reinstalls a blank Edge browser via winget but cannot restore deleted history, cookies, or user profile data.
whatItDoes: Uninstalls Microsoft Edge using winget and package removal scripts.
sideEffects: Microsoft Edge browser is permanently removed; system features relying on Edge or embedded WebViews may fail to open external links. Irreversible.

name: BitLocker - Disable
description: Disables BitLocker.
warnings: Disabling BitLocker removes disk encryption and leaves drive data completely unprotected against unauthorized physical access.
whatItDoes: Decrypts and disables BitLocker drive encryption across all detected system volumes.
sideEffects: Completely decrypts storage volumes, removing hardware-level data protection against offline physical access or theft.
sourceQuote: TEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker PreventDeviceEncryption REG_DWORD 0x1 For more information about device encryption, see BitLocker devic

name: Date & Time - Set Time to UTC
description: Essential for computers that are dual booting. Fixes the time sync with Linux systems.
whatItDoes: Sets RealTimeIsUniversal to 1 in HKLM system parameters, configuring the hardware RTC clock to UTC.
sideEffects: Configures Windows hardware clock to UTC (ideal for Linux dual-boot); may cause incorrect local time display if timezone is misconfigured in firmware.

name: Microsoft OneDrive - Remove
description: Denies permission to remove OneDrive user files, then uses its own uninstaller to remove it and restores the original permission afterward.

undo.script:
winget install Microsoft.OneDrive --source winget --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 3010 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne -1978335135 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne -1978335189) { throw "winget failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

warnings: Completely uninstalls OneDrive and stops file synchronization. Ensure all cloud documents are backed up locally. Undo reinstalls OneDrive via WinGet, but does NOT restore unsynced files or cached sync state.
irreversibleReason: Uninstalls Microsoft OneDrive client and stops synchronization; undo reinstalls OneDrive via winget and restores sync policies, but un-synced local changes and offline file cache are not restored.
whatItDoes: Terminates OneDrive processes and uninstalls the Microsoft OneDrive client from the system.
sideEffects: Removes OneDrive file synchronization and integration from File Explorer; local files stored only in the cloud will become inaccessible.

name: File Explorer Home and Gallery - Disable
description: Removes the Home and Gallery from Explorer and sets This PC as default.
whatItDoes: Hides the Home and Gallery nodes from the File Explorer navigation pane.
sideEffects: None known.

name: Visual Effects - Set to Best Performance
description: Sets the system preferences to performance. You can do this manually with sysdm.cpl as well.
whatItDoes: Adjusts graphics driver timeout detection recovery (TdrLevel, TdrDelay) in system graphics drivers.
sideEffects: Modifies display driver recovery timeouts; display driver crashes may freeze the entire operating system instead of recovering dynamically.

name: Disable Reserved Storage
description: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7-10 GB held for updates/temp files). Recommended only on small drives. Re-enable before major Windows feature updates to avoid installation failures.

apply.script:
DISM /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Disabled
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 3010) { throw "DISM failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

undo.script:
DISM /Online /Set-ReservedStorageState /State:Enabled
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -and $LASTEXITCODE -ne 3010) { throw "DISM failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

whatItDoes: Disables Windows Reserved Storage (7GB reserved for Windows Update staging) using fsutil.
sideEffects: Windows Update may fail during major feature updates if the primary storage drive runs low on free disk space.

name: Storage Sense - Disable
description: Storage Sense deletes temp files automatically.
whatItDoes: Configures Windows Storage Sense automated cleanup parameters and temporary file deletion policies.
sideEffects: Automatically deletes files in Downloads or Recycle Bin that have remained untouched longer than configured retention limits.

name: Windows AI - Disable And Remove
description: Removes and disables all AI features/packages
warnings: Removes and disables Windows AI, Recall, and Copilot packages system-wide. Undo only restores registry policies; removed AppX and Windows features are NOT reinstalled.
irreversibleReason: Permanently uninstalls Windows Copilot, Recall, and AI Appx packages; undo only reverts policy registry keys and does not reinstall the removed Appx or system features.
whatItDoes: Disables Windows Copilot and Recall features machine-wide through Group Policy registry keys.
sideEffects: Copilot taskbar button, Copilot sidebar, and AI-assisted Windows features will become unavailable.

name: Razer Software Auto-Install - Disable
description: Blocks ALL Razer Software installations. The hardware works fine without any software.
whatItDoes: Blocks Razer Synapse automatic hardware plug-and-play installer prompts in system software policies.
sideEffects: Razer peripheral setup and RGB configuration software must be downloaded and installed manually from the manufacturer's website.

name: Logitech Download Assistant Auto-Install - Disable
description: Blocks the Logi Download Assistant that Windows Update keeps reinstalling with Logitech device drivers. Logitech hardware keeps working without it.
whatItDoes: Blocks Logitech G-Hub and Options auto-install prompts when connecting hardware peripherals.
sideEffects: Logitech mouse and keyboard management software will not automatically install upon plugging in the device.

name: System Tray Notifications & Calendar - Disable
description: Disables all Notifications INCLUDING Calendar.
whatItDoes: Globally disables the Windows notification platform and Action Center alerts via system policies.
sideEffects: All application notifications, system security alerts, and Action Center banners will be suppressed.

name: Right-Click Menu Previous Layout - Enable
description: Restores the classic context menu when right-clicking in File Explorer, replacing the simplified Windows 11 version.
whatItDoes: Restores the classic Windows 10 style right-click context menu in Windows 11 File Explorer.
sideEffects: None known.

name: IPv6 - Set IPv4 as Preferred
description: Setting the IPv4 preference can have latency and security benefits on private networks where IPv6 is not configured.
whatItDoes: Configures IPv4 as the preferred protocol over IPv6 in the Windows TCP/IP prefix policy table.
sideEffects: Changes network routing preference; may break connectivity on modern IPv6-only networks or cellular hotspots.
sourceQuote: lSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters\ Name : DisabledComponents Type : REG_DWORD Min Value : 0x00 (default value) Max Value : 0xFF (IPv6 disabl

name: Teredo - Disable
description: Teredo network tunneling is an IPv6 feature that can cause additional latency, but may cause problems with some games.

apply.script:
netsh interface teredo set state disabled
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "netsh failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

undo.script:
netsh interface teredo set state default
      if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "netsh failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

whatItDoes: Disables the Teredo tunneling transition protocol in the network stack.
sideEffects: Disables IPv6-over-IPv4 tunneling; legacy multiplayer games or Xbox Live services that require Teredo NAT traversal may fail to connect.

name: IPv6 - Disable
description: Disables IPv6.
warnings: Disables IPv6 on all network adapters. Some modern networks and services requiring IPv6 may lose connectivity.
whatItDoes: Disables the IPv6 protocol stack across all active network interfaces.
sideEffects: Completely prevents communication over IPv6; can break connectivity with modern IPv6 services, corporate VPNs, and home networks.
sourceQuote: lSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters\ Name : DisabledComponents Type : REG_DWORD Min Value : 0x00 (default value) Max Value : 0xFF (IPv6 disabl

name: Background Apps - Disable
description: Disables all Microsoft Store apps from running in the background, which has to be done individually since Windows 11.
whatItDoes: Sets GlobalUserDisabled to 1 under BackgroundAccessApplications, preventing background execution of Store and UWP apps.
sideEffects: Prevents Windows Store and UWP applications from running or updating in the background when minimized.
